# FortiADC G32 captures (task netops-20261117-485)

Read on 2026-11-17 21:56–22:11 UTC from VM220, FortiADC-KVM 7.6.7 build0676, over SSH with a PTY
(`task-evidence/g32/adc_sh.py`, allowlist, no console or paging setting changed). The system administrator read
directly; `ro-capture.out` and `exec-ro-refused.out` are reads of the read-only profile `netops-read` through the
VM201 transit.

Each file is the command echo, the unchanged answer and the next prompt (as in the G28 captures). The `exec-*.out`
files are instead the unchanged stdout of the SSH exec channel (no PTY) that the Helper uses for these catalogue
queries, read with `task-evidence/g32/adc_exec.py` at 22:26 UTC: there the appliance prints every
`Settings for portN:` block (speed, duplex, link) first and the `Interface: portN` lines with the counter tables last.
`exec-ro-refused.out` is the stdout of all three reads by `netops-read` (identical); the appliance wrote
`Parsing error at '<word>'. err=1` to stderr, which the exec stdout does not contain.

- ADC-C12: `system-interface-all.out` (`get system interface`), `netlink-interface-list-all.out`
  (`diagnose netlink interface list` without a name), `nic-detail-all.out`
  (`diagnose hardware get deviceinfo nic-detail` without a name).
- ADC-G11 (`diagnose sniffer packet <port> '<filter>' 4 <count> a`), traffic generated by curl from the VM201
  client through VS_APP_HTTP:
  - `capture-client-vs.out`: client and virtual-server pair with port 80 on port2, count 6 reached;
  - `capture-backend-pair.out`: appliance (SNAT address) and backend RS_A pair with port 80 on port3, count 4
    reached;
  - `capture-count-50.out`: count 50 reached;
  - `capture-deadline-50.out`: client with port 80, count 50, interrupted (Ctrl-C) after 27 packets, with the
    device summary;
  - `capture-no-match-interrupted.out`: an unused host, interrupted after 4 s, 0 packets;
  - `capture-unknown-interface.out` (`pcap_open_live`) and `capture-invalid-filter.out` (`pcap_compile`);
  - `ro-capture.out`: the read-only profile (`Parsing error at 'sniffer'`, -284).

Anonymised on PC-Radek with `tests/support/anonymize_fixture.py --map` (map kept outside the repository and
deleted) and a second pass `task-evidence/g32/anon_ip_port.py` with the same /24 mapping for tcpdump-style
`address.port` words, which the anonymiser leaves unchanged; `--check` of the result returned 0 and no lab address
remained. Mapping: backend network 192.0.2.0/24 (appliance .1, RS_A .11), client network 198.51.100.0/24 (client .100,
virtual server .10, an unused host .99), management 203.0.113.0/24. Times, sequence numbers and counters are as read.
